book.name: REPELESIN
book.title: Repelesin Kandja seke pai ge Krais dje pene wori

content: Sipsip Wombe ne, una 144,000
Alla na kanill, kam mekbe Sion we dji yei al ge Sipsip Wombe aglo moika una 144,000 une boll aike moi. Ga mambrne al ge, une kandjiye ne, yene Ne kandjiye bolo wori pai.
Kupill al ge, na pill, nu kerman to mu djindo mal embe djika, kam kal kerman djindo mal djika, una gita tonjka mu djindo mal embe dji.

God sia king al moi, wal 4 pela gun moi wal ge molmaka, ngambalne pai una 24 pela ge molmaka yei. Ga porapora moi al ge una molo gollang gun ta dji. Ba una kiwa gollang ge djine kune nayenda, man. Ga God una 144,000 top to i yem wori una ge, djine kune yenda.

Ga yenekne gaklene kanpol toi, ana boll singare ke ta nayei, kiwa moi. Sipsip Wombe pundo al ge ga are pinj. Ga una boll moi ge, une top to i djell wori, wal bo asamoll tondo mal embe molmaka soka God ne, Sipsip Wombe mopill al i opa awi mal embe moi.
Ga djillakene al kandja kende taimanta kaima nadji, wambo ta napai.
Tau agelo sokara kandja dje pene wori

Are tau agelo ta kupill al pakna pir dje pi kanill. Makimb al una porapora moi ge, unaiwa kayekaye moi ge ne, epil kayekaye moi ge ne, una kandja tokples kayekaye dji moi ge ne, una gaklene djelldjell pai moi ge, ga porapora moi al une Jisas kandjiyebe wopake ege ege pa punda kandja ge, dje auno dje yemoi.

Une kandja kerman dje awo embe dji, God una kot ye aunda poke woi pora dji. Ye God pille kand golo, yene kandjiye amblo pla woro aune. Iwa kupill makimb beke, solwara ne, nu pir beke yei iwa moro ge ye une kandjiye dje pla woro aune.

Are tau agelo namba 2 wo embe dji, Babilon taun una kerman ge yage kal toi, yage kal toi pora dje keri. Ga djingdjang ke ninga dje yei mal ge nu dongall noi mal embe moi. Ga unaiwa porapora dje i pakna wormaka ga singare ke yei mal embe yei.
Are tau agelo namba 3 wo kandja kerman dje embe dji, una yenekne mambrne al mo, aglene al wal simbill makiye i pagle, wal simbill lotu ye awo, yene piksaye lotu ye awi dal,

nu wain mal embe nane. Ge God elle kerawa kaima kumbso tano dje pro mal ge, nane. Tau agelo wopake ta mal nalene al ge ne, Sipsip Wombe nale al ge, ga ku salpa wamo do paro al molo ngembill kerman goye.

Wamo do pai ge, pakna moyeke, wamo er ge, ege ege er pla po pamoyaka pora nadjinda. Ga wal simbill pille lotu ye awo, yene piksaye lotu ye awo, yene kandjiye i pille, ege ege ngembill golo imina armina waka namoye.
Wal embe pillau djinda poke ge, una Jisas boll pillgi dje, God lo dje awi karkar yemoye kambono ge, ga aglo gi dje, Jisas boll pillgi dje pamoye, nakerne.

Una nubke ta kupill al kandja dje na moll al embe dji, ni pepa bolo embe djimben, ipon ne are yenda ge, una Iwa Kerman kandjiye al ta goi dal, God ye wopake ye aunda una moye we dje bopen we dji. Djika God Murble kandja embe dji, owo, God kaima ye wopake ye aunda moye. Ga kogo kusno bolo ye wani ge, kere alla waka moye. Singare wopake yei al ge pille waka moye.
Wit boi pora dji God i nonda mal paro
Are kupa kuruwo ta pai al na kanill, Una Wombe mal embe ta ami dje moi. Yene ngambale al king kon pula gol ta kake, djekapill kum noi ta amblo moi.
Moika tau agelo ta lotu numb kerman kere wo une kupa al ami dje moi ge kandja kerman dje embe dji, wit pai ge to imben mal paro. Makimb al wit boi pora dji, ni djein kapill ipo to imben we dji.
Dji mal ge kupa al ami dje moi una yene djeye kapill i makimb al wit porapora bolo pai ge to i.
Ika tau agelo ta God lotu numb kerman kupill al yei ge kere er woi. Yene djeye kapill kum noi ta para amblo i woi.

Tau agelo ta alta al wamo do pai kantau yemoi iwa ge, wo tau agelo djekapill kum noi amblo iwi una ge moi al kandja dje awo embe dji, wain megiye makimb al moro ge bo toi pora dji, ni djein kapill i to imben we dji.
Dji mal ge tau agelo yene djeye kapill i wain megiye bo to moi ge, tako i makai to molo po God wain megiye kamblo djerpall yewordo al ge pup to pakna wori. Yei al ge God elle kumbsi al ge yei.
Siti orkokill wain megiye ge kamblo djerpall yewormaka, meyam merkeke toi ge er orko wo kog os paune
paro mal ge, er pla embe wo, makimb amblo wai dje 300 kilomita mal embe pi.

footnotes.text: 14.20 Grik os paune al we nadjindo, Grik kandja embe djindo, ain kog os djillakene al paro ge, meyam er pla embe woi we djindo.
